q10_bp_limit: 180/110 (may use his portable oxygen and walker during the assessment)
q16_how: Severe COPD (FEV1 38% predicted) with oxygen dependence and heart failure: must stop to rest after about 50 feet; O2 saturation falls to 85% with minimal walking. Cannot walk the 3 blocks to the bus stop or 0.8 mile to the rail station, and cannot stand more than 5-10 minutes waiting. Uses a rollator walker and portable oxygen for all travel. Two falls in the past year.
q17_explain: Furosemide (diuretic) causes urinary urgency for several hours each morning, making long waits and rides without restroom access difficult.
q18_explain: Cold air and hot, humid days trigger COPD exacerbations with severe shortness of breath; cannot wait outdoors at stops in temperature extremes.
q19_explain: High fall risk walking with a rollator and oxygen tank on ice or snow; two falls in the past year.
q20_explain: Poor air-quality days trigger COPD exacerbations. Uses rescue albuterol inhaler as needed; on daily maintenance inhalers. Hospitalized for COPD exacerbations 01/2025 and 02/2026.
q21_other: Chronic hypoxic respiratory failure requiring oxygen 2 L/min with exertion; bilateral knee osteoarthritis limiting walking and stairs; lives in a 2nd-floor walk-up (14 stairs).
